source: A heatproof bucket carrying one source of molten rock.
en: A heatproof bucket carrying one source of molten rock.
de: Ein hitzefester Eimer mit einer Quelle geschmolzenen Gesteins.

source: Viscous molten rock carrying small fragments of crust.
en: Viscous molten rock carrying small fragments of crust.

source: Fine grey cinders on the floor of an old lava valley.

source: Black volcanic rock fractured into pillars.
en: Black volcanic rock fractured into pillars.

source: Dense purple-black rock with a chipped surface.

source: Scalding steam escapes through this burning vent.
